'''Bera Jeza''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] biologist who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Bera Jeza was in the middle of selling us some sort of super soldier drug and Jabba is very interested in getting his hands on the chemical makeup.|Bib Fortuna, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BJE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bera Jeza's Employer|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Bera Jeza resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where she had a job as lab assistant at the [[Mos Eisley Biolab]]. In the meantime, she was also secretly working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and was involved in [[Spice/Legends|spice]] manufacturing.<ref name="SWG:GC" />

At some point, her employer, the scientist [[Derg Prantis]], obtained a sample of the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientist. Prantis therefore built a [[Secret Laboratory|secret laboratory]] on the remote planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] to conduct his own research on the virus in order to create a super soldier drug. The scientist recruited Bera Jeza to help him the project. However, Jeza soon betrayed her employer and contacted Jabba the Hutt to sell him the super soldier drug.<ref name="SWG:TP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Plan|Tatooine}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Bera Jeza was about to meet [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], Jabba's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], when she was assassinated in a street of Mos Eisley. [[Mos Eisley Police Authority|Mos Eisley Police]] officer [[Happer]] was tasked to investigate the murder. In the meanwhile, Bib Fortuna hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate whether Jeza's bargain with Jabba was related to the crime.<ref name="SWG:GC" /> The spacer would then discover the assassination of Derg Prantis,<ref name="SWG:BJE" /> as well as the secret research project on Lok.<ref name="SWG:TP" /> The investigation eventually led to the discovery of a [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|Blackwing virus outbreak]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:ID">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Investigate Dathomir|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bera Jeza appeared as a dead [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Bera Jeza was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]," released on [[September 30]], [[2009]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> This NPC was part of the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:GC" /> an introduction to the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
